request_summary: Rerun the GEC suite on DEV with a temporary table endpoint override and report directly on failure.

actions.description: Ran the approved behave command once; 51 of 52 scenarios passed and gec_002_09 failed on the Poste bundle absence assertion. Reported counts, exit code, artifacts and tested state, and appended the error section to the existing Markdown report.
The orchestrator reread the console log summary lines and the dev.yaml state; the log confirms 51 passed and 1 failed scenarios.

outcome.detail: The run completed and the result is consistent with the log; issuer setup and teardown outcomes could not be established from the console output.

friction.description: A stderr warning from the suite became a terminating error under strict error handling in PowerShell 5.1, so the runner relaxed error handling just before launch; the exit code was still the real behave status.
The hook log lines for issuer setup are not visible in the console output or log file, so setup and restore status stayed unverified.
